newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wing Tai buys hotel for S$200 mln.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tai buys hotel for S$200 mln.

text.p: Property based Wing Tai Holdings Ltd has bought a Singapore hotel and three adjoining properties for Singapore $200 million, real estate company Edmund Tie & Company said on Thursday.
An Edmund Tie statement said Richdeal Investment Pte Ltd, a Wing Tai subsidiary, had bought the Cairnhill Hotel and three adjoining conservation terrace houses.
Wing Tai had paid option money of S$8 million to the vendor, Cairnhill Hotel Pte Ltd.
The site of the properties have a total land area of 5,915.23 sq metres.
The hotel comprises a 12-storey tower with 195 rooms and approval had been obtained for a proposed hotel extension which would increase number of rooms to 340.
